from parking import fee

    assert fee(20) == 0

    assert fee(150) == 6
E
P=/private/tmp/msr104-venv/bin/python
$P -m pytest -q tests/test_parking.py 2>&1 | tail -8
cat > parking.py <<'E'
FREE_MINUTES = 30
RATE_PER_HOUR = 2


def fee(minutes: int) -> int:
    if minutes <= FREE_MINUTES:
        return 0
    started_hours = -(-minutes // 60)
    return RATE_PER_HOUR * started_hours
E
$P -m pytest -q tests/test_parking.py 2>&1 | tail -3

cd /private/tmp/msr104/rep3/repo; git add parking.py tests/test_parking.py; git commit -q -m "Add the parking fee" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"; git log --oneline | head -2
